title: Return 404 for GET /api/tickets/{id} when the ticket does not exist
evidence: var/log/dev.log: Error 'Call to a member function toArray() on null' TicketController.php:54 (x1, GET /api/tickets/9999)
observed: Requesting an unknown ticket id returns HTTP 500.
expected: A 404 JSON response. The log does not state this expectation. 404 is the standard behaviour, and the spec-writer should confirm the error body shape.
